transition_rules.outofstock: Keep URL. Verify availability copy/schema. Do not infer discontinuation.
transition_rules.onbackorder: Keep URL and represent backorder accurately.
transition_rules.discontinued_explicit: Requires explicit evidence and a separate keep/replace/redirect/410 decision.
transition_rules.stale_content: Queue substantive review only; no dateModified write without real content change.
transition_rules.duplicate_or_superseded: Requires canonical/redirect plan and post-write readback before any deprecation.
transition_rules.governance_asset: Review when evidence, routing, compatibility model, or source validity materially changes.
